marks.gloss_en: דאמור כרבי יוסי, דתנן: רבי יוסי מטמא
הכא נמי שבססן ממש -- he actually trampled them, an act (= p_okimta_bsasan_mamash)
here too (the baraita): where he actually trampled them
וכי תימא: that is for vessels, which are significant; handles, which serve eating, go by thought (= p_yadot_bemachshava_salka, itself attacked from the handles mishnah -- see header)
והתנן: כל ידות האוכלין שבססן בגורן טהורות -- בשלמא למאן דאמר בססן התיר אגודן שפיר, אלא למאן דאמר בססן ממש מאי איכא למימר? (14a.3): on that reading handles leave their status only by an act
(proposed) that holds of vessels, which are significant; handles, which exist only for eating, become handles by thought and cease by thought
האי מאי? there R' Yosei's reason is that the handles are fit for turning with a pitchfork; here what are they fit for?
Reish Lakish: (R' Yosei renders them impure) since they are fit for turning (the grain) with a pitchfork
חזיא לכי סתר, למנקט להו בגילייהו (= p_chazya_lechi_satar)
here they are fit for when he dismantles (the roofing), to hold them by their stalks
בשלמא לרבי (אליעזר) ... היינו דמטמא רבי יוסי; אלא לרבי יוחנן דאמר בססן ממש, אמאי מטמא רבי יוסי?
הואיל וראויות להופכן בעתר (= p_reish_lakish_eter)
all vessels enter impurity by thought and leave it only by a change through an act; an act negates act and thought, thought negates neither
R' Yochanan: בססן means actually trampled
R' Elazar: the prayer of the righteous is likened to a pitchfork
אין בהן ארבעה, ואפילו פחות משלשה, הא קנים בעלמא נינהו? -- under four would include under three, and those are merely reeds; why would R' Meir forbid?
הכי קאמר: four -- all pasul; under three -- all kasher, mere reeds; they dispute three to four (= p_pappa_machloket_shlosha_ad_arba)
under three, all agree it is kesheira -- why? they are merely reeds

תנן: נתן עליה נסר שהוא רחב ארבעה ... ובלבד שלא יישן תחתיו -- for Shmuel (four is unanimously pasul) that is why one does not sleep beneath it; but for Rav, on R' Yehuda's view boards of four are kasher, so why not sleep beneath it?
מי סברת דברי הכל היא? סיפא אתאן לרבי מאיר -- the seifa is R' Meir's alone

תא שמע: שני סדינין מצטרפין, שני נסרין אין מצטרפין, רבי מאיר אומר אף נסרין כסדינין -- for Shmuel 'combine' is to four (14b.2); for Rav, היכי דמי? if each has four, why combine? if not, why forbid -- they are merely reeds! (14b.3)
two sheets combine
one may roof [the sukkah] with boards -- R' Yehuda
Rav: the dispute concerns boards that have [a width of] four
